customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid or content hash)

name.meaning: customer's full name as entered on the profile; a locating clue only, never an identity credential

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered on the profile; an identity credential

email.meaning: email address registered on the profile (sign-in email); an identity credential

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address on the card on file; an identity credential

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the default payment card on file; an identity credential

member_since.meaning: date the customer profile was opened; an identity credential

shipping_state.meaning: state of the default shipping address; the residency basis for pharmacy dispensing law and delivery zones

fresh_delivery_eligible.meaning: whether the default shipping ZIP is inside the refrigerated (cold-chain) delivery zone, as set by the carrier zone table

home_store_id.meaning: customer's preferred store (foreign key -> stores); empty when none chosen

pet_id.meaning: primary id of the pet profile

pet_name.meaning: pet's name as entered by the owner

breed.meaning: breed as entered by the owner or the clinic

date_of_birth.meaning: pet's date of birth (estimated birth dates are recorded as the first of the month)

weight_recorded_on.meaning: date the current weight_lb was recorded

size_class.meaning: size band derived from weight_lb for dogs: toy under 10.0 lb, small 10.0-24.9, medium 25.0-49.9, large 50.0-89.9, giant 90.0 and over; cats and other species are recorded as small

coat_type.meaning: coat type used by the grooming salon

temperament_flag.meaning: behaviour flag set by salon, clinic or trainer staff after an incident or assessment

rabies_expires_on.meaning: expiry date of the current rabies vaccination certificate on file; empty when none on file

core_vaccine_expires_on.meaning: expiry date of the current core combination vaccine on file (DHPP for dogs, FVRCP for cats); empty when none on file

bordetella_expires_on.meaning: expiry date of the current bordetella vaccination on file (dogs only); empty when none on file

primary_vet_id.meaning: veterinarian of record for this pet (foreign key -> veterinarians); empty when none

vet_id.meaning: primary id of the veterinarian record

clinic_phone.meaning: practice phone number used by the pharmacy for authorizations

dea_registered.meaning: whether the veterinarian holds a DEA registration (required to prescribe controlled substances)

tailwise_clinic.meaning: whether the veterinarian practises inside a Tailwise Vet Clinic

has_salon.meaning: whether the store has a grooming salon

has_vet_clinic.meaning: whether the store has a Tailwise Vet Clinic

has_training.meaning: whether the store offers training classes

autoship_id.meaning: primary id of the Autoship subscription

pet_id.meaning: pet the item is for (foreign key -> pets); empty when the program does not require a pet profile

variant_name.meaning: Autoship program, written as the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the subscription (see the charter lifecycle)

sku.meaning: item number of the subscribed item

item_description.meaning: catalog description of the subscribed item

unit_price_usd.meaning: current catalog price per unit; the price on the processing date is the price charged

next_ship_date.meaning: date the next scheduled shipment will be processed; a skip, change or resume moves it

paused_until.meaning: last day of the current pause; empty unless paused

cancelled_on.meaning: date the subscription was cancelled; empty while not cancelled

rx_prescription_id.meaning: linked prescription (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions); empty for non-pharmacy programs

plan_basis_weight_lb.meaning: pet weight the Custom Meal Plan portions were calculated from; empty for other programs

billed_total_usd.meaning: net amount billed on this subscription to date: the sum of shipment charges minus claim refunds

autoship_event_id.meaning: primary id of the Autoship ledger row

autoship_id.meaning: subscription the row belongs to (foreign key -> autoship_subscriptions)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

scheduled_ship_date.meaning: the scheduled ship date the row concerns (for a ship-now shipment, its processing date)

shipment_kind.meaning: kind of shipment the row concerns; none for rows that are not about a shipment

shipment_seq.meaning: ordinal of a charged shipment on the subscription, 1 for the first; 0 on rows that are not charges

quantity.meaning: units shipped, or units claimed on a refund or reship row

unit_price_usd.meaning: price per unit charged on the shipment

merchandise_subtotal_usd.meaning: quantity x unit price before discounts

shipping_fee_usd.meaning: standard shipping fee charged, or refunded on a refund row

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the row, always positive; the event type fixes whether it is billed or refunded

original_event_id.meaning: the shipment charge row a refund, reship or payment row refers to (foreign key -> autoship_events); empty otherwise

claim_reason.meaning: reason of a claim row; none otherwise

refund_method.meaning: where a refund was sent; none on non-refund rows

skip_reason.meaning: why a scheduled shipment was skipped; none on non-skip rows

rx_prescription_id.meaning: prescription filled by a pharmacy shipment (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions); empty on all other rows

payment_attempt.meaning: 1 for the first decline of a scheduled shipment, 2 and up for automatic retries; 0 on other rows

rx_prescription_id.meaning: primary id of the prescription record (one medication, strength and pet)

variant_name.meaning: prescription class, written as the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the prescription (see the charter lifecycle)

medication.meaning: medication or diet name as written on the label

strength.meaning: strength or formula as written on the label

sku.meaning: item number of the package dispensed

origin.meaning: how the prescription came to the pharmacy

renewal_of_rx_id.meaning: prescription this one renews (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions); empty unless origin is renewal

transfer_count.meaning: transfers in and out over the life of this prescription

ordered_on.meaning: date the order or transfer request was placed

authorized_on.meaning: date the veterinarian's authorization was recorded; empty while pending

expires_on.meaning: last day before which the prescription may be filled: a fill dated on or after this date is not allowed; empty while pending

fills_authorized.meaning: fills authorized in total (first fill plus refills)

fills_remaining.meaning: fills still available: fills authorized minus fills dispensed plus fills restored

denial_reason.meaning: why the authorization was denied; none unless denied

closed_on.meaning: date the prescription left the fillable states; empty while pending or active

rx_event_id.meaning: primary id of the pharmacy ledger row

rx_prescription_id.meaning: prescription the row belongs to (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

event_date.meaning: date of the fill, refund or credit

fill_number.meaning: ordinal of a dispensed fill on the prescription, 1 for the first; 0 on other rows

fill_channel.meaning: how a fill was ordered; none on non-fill rows

days_supply.meaning: days' supply dispensed on the row

shipping_fee_usd.meaning: standard shipping fee charged or refunded

service_fee_usd.meaning: compounding and adult-signature fees charged or refunded

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the row, always positive; the event type fixes whether it is billed or refunded

fills_remaining_after.meaning: fills_remaining on the prescription right after the row

override_reason.meaning: early-refill override used for the fill

original_event_id.meaning: fill a remake, refund or credit refers to (foreign key -> rx_events); empty otherwise

auth_request_id.meaning: primary id of the authorization request

rx_prescription_id.meaning: prescription the request is for (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions)

request_kind.meaning: what is being asked of the veterinarian or the transferring pharmacy

attempt_number.meaning: 1 for the first attempt, then 2, 3 on follow-ups

responded_on.meaning: date the outcome was recorded; empty while pending

groom_pass_id.meaning: primary id of the grooming pass

pet_id.meaning: pet the pass is for (foreign key -> pets); changes only on a pass transfer

variant_name.meaning: grooming pass, written as the official pass name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the pass (see the charter lifecycle)

size_class_at_purchase.meaning: the pet's size class when the pass was bought; the price basis

store_id.meaning: salon where the pass was bought (foreign key -> stores); visits may be booked at any Tailwise salon

price_paid_usd.meaning: amount paid for the pass after its discount (for Groom Club Monthly, the first monthly fee)

discount_kind.meaning: the single discount applied to the purchase

expires_on.meaning: last day on which a visit may be redeemed; for Groom Club Monthly, the end of the current billing month

next_billing_date.meaning: next monthly billing date of Groom Club Monthly; empty for prepaid passes

visits_remaining.meaning: visits available: credits minus visits used, forfeited, expired or refunded

extension_used.meaning: whether the one-time expiry extension has been granted

closed_on.meaning: date the pass left status active or suspended for good; empty otherwise

groom_event_id.meaning: primary id of the salon ledger row

groom_pass_id.meaning: pass the row belongs to (foreign key -> groom_passes)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

pet_id.meaning: pet serviced or booked (foreign key -> pets)

addon_fee_usd.meaning: add-on fee charged after any membership discount

size_difference_usd.meaning: single-visit price difference charged for a larger size class

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the row, always positive; the event type fixes whether it is billed or refunded

visits_delta.meaning: visits credited or removed by the row, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

visits_remaining_after.meaning: visits_remaining on the pass right after the row

notice_hours.meaning: full hours between the cancellation and the appointment start

minutes_late.meaning: minutes after the start time the pet arrived; 0 when on time or not arrived

original_event_id.meaning: booking or visit a cancellation, fee, forfeit, no-show or redo refers to (foreign key -> groom_events); empty otherwise

billing_month.meaning: billing month of a Groom Club Monthly charge or decline; empty otherwise

consent_id.meaning: primary id of the consent record

customer_id.meaning: owner giving or refusing consent (foreign key -> customers)

groom_pass_id.meaning: pass the appointment is booked on (foreign key -> groom_passes)

original_event_id.meaning: booking the consent is for (foreign key -> groom_events)

consent_kind.meaning: what the owner is asked to agree to

recorded_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
recorded_at.meaning: moment the owner's decision was recorded

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the rewards membership (one per customer)

variant_name.meaning: membership tier, written as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (see the charter lifecycle)

enrolled_on.meaning: date the customer first joined Pals Rewards

tier_effective_on.meaning: date the current tier took effect

plus_term_start.meaning: start of the current paid term; empty on free tiers

plus_term_end.meaning: last day of the current paid term; empty on free tiers

next_billing_date.meaning: next fee date of a paid tier; empty on free tiers or when not renewing

auto_renew.meaning: whether the paid term renews automatically

trial_end_date.meaning: last day of a free trial; empty when no trial

downgrade_effective_on.meaning: date a requested cancellation of a paid tier takes effect; empty otherwise

points_balance.meaning: current points: earned and bonus points minus reversed, redeemed, expired and forfeited points

perk_credit_balance_usd.meaning: unused perk credit of the current term

closed_on.meaning: date the rewards account was closed; empty otherwise

member_event_id.meaning: primary id of the rewards ledger row

membership_id.meaning: membership the row belongs to (foreign key -> member_memberships)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

source_category.meaning: program the earning or reversed purchase came from

source_event_id.meaning: the purchase record (shipment charge, fill, visit, pass, order line, enrollment or plan payment) that earned or reversed the points; empty when not purchase-based

qualifying_spend_usd.meaning: spend that earned or reversed points

points.meaning: points moved by the row, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

pet_id.meaning: pet a birthday bonus is for (foreign key -> pets); empty otherwise

certificate_value_usd.meaning: value of an issued or reissued certificate

certificate_expires_on.meaning: last day an issued or reissued certificate can be used

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of the billing period a fee row covers

amount_usd.meaning: fee charged, attempted or refunded, always positive

original_event_id.meaning: row a refund, reissue or credit use refers to (foreign key -> member_events, or the service record the perk credit paid for); empty otherwise

refund_method.meaning: where a fee refund was sent

order_id.meaning: primary id of the retail order

values: Buy Online Pick Up In Store
variant_name.meaning: fulfillment method, written as the official method name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the order (see the charter lifecycle)

placed_on.meaning: date the order was placed, after the cutoff rule

store_id.meaning: store fulfilling a pickup or same-day order (foreign key -> stores); empty for warehouse shipments

promised_date.meaning: date delivery or pickup readiness was promised

promised_window_end.meaning: end of the promised same-day delivery window; empty for other methods

completed_date.meaning: date the order was delivered or picked up; empty until then

completed_time.meaning: time the order was delivered or picked up; empty until then

alternate_pickup_name.meaning: full name of the alternate pickup person exactly as the customer gave it; empty when none

pickup_extension_used.meaning: whether the one-time pickup hold extension was granted

substitutions_allowed.meaning: whether the customer allowed substitutions at checkout

billed_total_usd.meaning: net amount billed on the order: line and fee charges minus cancellations, refunds and credits

cancelled_on.meaning: date the order was cancelled; empty otherwise

order_event_id.meaning: primary id of the order ledger row

order_id.meaning: order the row belongs to (foreign key -> orders)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

line_number.meaning: line number on the order; 0 on fee rows

item_description.meaning: catalog description of the line item

item_category.meaning: return-policy category of the item; none on fee rows

final_sale.meaning: whether the item was sold final sale

quantity.meaning: units charged, cancelled, returned, credited or replaced

coupon_discount_usd.meaning: coupon amount allocated to the line, positive

certificate_applied_usd.meaning: rewards certificate amount allocated to the line, positive

deduction_usd.meaning: label, pickup or restocking fee withheld from a refund

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the row, always positive; the event type fixes whether it is billed or refunded

fee_kind.meaning: kind of fee charged or refunded

original_event_id.meaning: line or fee charge a cancellation, refund, credit or replacement refers to (foreign key -> order_events); empty otherwise

return_reason.meaning: reason given for a refund, credit or replacement

rma_id.meaning: return authorization the refund settles (foreign key -> order_return_requests); empty otherwise
primary id of the return authorization

original_event_id.meaning: the order line being returned (foreign key -> order_events)

return_method.meaning: how the item will come back

received_on.meaning: date the item reached a store or the returns center; empty until then

vet_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the wellness plan

variant_name.meaning: wellness plan, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (see the charter lifecycle)

store_id.meaning: home Tailwise Vet Clinic (foreign key -> stores)

enrolled_on.meaning: date the plan was first enrolled

term_start.meaning: first day of the current term

term_end.meaning: last day of the current term

next_payment_date.meaning: next monthly fee date; empty when paid in full

fees_paid_usd.meaning: fees paid in the current term, enrollment fee excluded

services_value_used_usd.meaning: list value of included services redeemed in the current term

cancelled_on.meaning: date the plan was cancelled; empty otherwise

vet_event_id.meaning: primary id of the plan ledger row

vet_plan_id.meaning: plan the row belongs to (foreign key -> vet_plans)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

event_date.meaning: date of the fee, service or settlement

service_code.meaning: service redeemed or discounted; none on fee rows

service_seq.meaning: ordinal of this service code in the current term, 1 for the first

list_value_usd.meaning: clinic list price of the service on the service date

discount_usd.meaning: plan discount given on a non-included service

amount_usd.meaning: amount billed, refunded or settled, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

billing_month.meaning: month a fee row covers; empty otherwise

original_event_id.meaning: row a void or refund refers to (foreign key -> vet_plan_events); empty otherwise

cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the cancellation request

requested_on.meaning: date the customer asked to cancel

train_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the training enrollment

variant_name.meaning: course or pack, written as the official name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (see the charter lifecycle)

store_id.meaning: store where sessions are held (foreign key -> stores)

enrollment_kind.meaning: whether the enrollment was bought or is a free guarantee repeat

repeat_of_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment a guarantee repeat is for (foreign key -> train_enrollments); empty otherwise

class_start_date.meaning: date of the first scheduled session

expires_on.meaning: last day sessions may be used

sessions_remaining.meaning: sessions credited minus sessions attended or forfeited

closed_on.meaning: date the enrollment was completed, withdrawn or expired; empty otherwise

train_event_id.meaning: primary id of the training ledger row

train_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the row belongs to (foreign key -> train_enrollments)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

event_date.meaning: date of the session or booking

session_number.meaning: scheduled session number in the course, or the ordinal of a private session

notice_hours.meaning: full hours of notice given before the session

sessions_delta.meaning: sessions credited or used by the row, always positive

amount_usd.meaning: refund or fee amount, always positive

original_event_id.meaning: session a makeup refers to (foreign key -> train_sessions); empty otherwise

livepet_guarantee_id.meaning: primary id of the live animal guarantee (one per live animal purchase line)

variant_name.meaning: guarantee, written as the official guarantee name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the guarantee (see the charter lifecycle)

species_description.meaning: species or common name as printed on the purchase record

coverage_value_usd.meaning: covered value remaining: price paid minus remedies given

closed_on.meaning: date the guarantee was settled or expired; empty otherwise

livepet_event_id.meaning: primary id of the guarantee ledger row

livepet_guarantee_id.meaning: guarantee the row belongs to (foreign key -> livepet_guarantees)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the charter

event_date.meaning: date of the test, exam, claim or remedy

animals_claimed.meaning: animals covered by the claim or remedy

amount_usd.meaning: value of the remedy, always positive

original_event_id.meaning: claim a remedy settles (foreign key -> livepet_events); empty otherwise

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record (content hash of the customer id)

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values
